explanation.bottleneck: The supplied mapped paths show substantial combinational depth and buffering between registers, but do not identify exact RTL endpoints. A plausible contributor in the reference is the masked priority-encoding path followed by encoded-index decoding or variable-shift mask generation and blocking/reset selection.
explanation.area_or_other_cost: Parallel overlapping reductions can increase combinational area, routing, and fanout, although synthesis may share common terms. Register count is unchanged. Compliance with the 4880.43072 um2 mapped-area cap is not established without mapping.
explanation.rewrite: Replace the helper instances with top-local parallel priority suppression. Produce each one-hot winner directly from its request bit and a reduction of higher-priority requests. Encode the selected winner with OR reductions. Most importantly, compute each next-mask bit directly from a reduction of higher-priority requests, independently of the encoded index: for MSB priority, mask bit i is the OR of requests above i; for LSB priority, it is the OR below i. Select between masked and unmasked results while retaining the original blocking and sequential update rules.
explanation.expected_timing_gain: Unmeasured. The rewrite removes the encoded-index-to-one-hot decode and encoded-index-to-variable-shift dependencies, particularly shortening the prospective mask-register feedback path. Balanced reductions may also reduce priority-selection depth. Actual WNS improvement over the supplied 7.8 ns baseline requires synthesis and STA at the fixed settings.
explanation.functional_boundaries: Preserves the top interface, parameter names/defaults, original register initialization values, single positive-edge clock, synchronous active-high reset, blocking conditions, and output latency. Handles arbitrary multi-bit request and acknowledge vectors without input one-hot assumptions. A held grant also holds the round-robin mask; an idle cycle clears grant outputs while retaining the mask. No helper module is redefined. Equivalence against the original frozen RTL under the unchanged startup contract, including later resets, remains to be verified.
output_format_normalization: Removed complete leading think wrapper before JSON parsing
